tasks.title: Secure FFmpeg render worker lifecycle
acceptance: Owned source asset registration and hash-verified staging
Durable render job state with lease fencing and crash recovery
Allowlisted FFmpeg binary and argv-only execution; no shell or arbitrary URLs
Bounded input size, clip count, CPU, memory and runtime
Audio mixing and ffprobe output validation
external_gates: Production filesystem isolation and resource limits
implemented_increment: Workspace-scoped private asset staging with server-side SHA-256, size limits, quarantine state and hash verification on access
Immutable normalized EDL v1 snapshots with database update/delete guards and workspace authorization
Idempotent timeline_render queue handoff carrying snapshot ID, digest and normalized EDL
Atomic immutable EDL snapshot and timeline_render queue insertion in one caller-owned SQLite transaction with rollback-safe idempotency
Regression tests inject snapshot insertion failure and prove the queue row and enqueue event roll back together; idempotent replay returns the same snapshot and job

Latest integrated CI after atomic handoff: backend validation and Playwright browser smoke passed in run 44797035282; real FFmpeg/ffprobe Compose render, artifact adoption, review and backup/restore passed in run 44797035258
Lease-fenced timeline worker with heartbeat, generation-token checks and review_pending completion
Shell-free FFmpeg audio-mix argv builder with bounded tracks, trims, fades, gain and limiter
Regression tests for asset isolation, snapshot immutability, queue handoff, worker transitions and audio argv validation
Lease-fenced checksum-verified render artifact adoption with workspace-scoped immutable records and atomic review_pending handoff
Worker integration and regression coverage for stale generation rejection, snapshot binding, private staging boundaries, byte limits and artifact tamper detection
Grace-period reconciliation of orphaned private artifact files after process crashes, serialized against active adoption
Bounded shell-free ffprobe validation helper with timeout, file/stream/duration limits and optional artifact-adoption metadata persistence
Concrete shell-free FFmpeg EDL v1 video renderer for contiguous video clips with bounded dimensions, frame rate, threads and runtime
Optional trusted audio-bed mix and mux stage connected to the EDL render pipeline
Worker factory wiring queue-owned workspace identity, snapshot creator membership, verified clean asset path resolution and lease-fenced artifact adoption
Black timeline-gap segments and configured-font title-card rendering in the FFmpeg EDL graph
Optional source-clip audio discovery through bounded ffprobe, source trim and timeline offset mixing with trusted audio beds
Probe source video metadata and reject EDL source trims that exceed trusted media duration when ffprobe is configured
Authenticated workspace-scoped raw media upload API with bounded streaming and quarantine-only registration
Authenticated EDL render submission and idempotency API backed by immutable snapshots and durable queue
Workspace-scoped render status and integrity-checked private artifact preview/download API
Route-level tests for upload quarantine, upload byte limits, workspace-scoped submission and non-member denial
Optional fail-closed ClamAV scan gate for private workspace uploads; only trusted clean attestation promotes assets from pending
Workspace-scoped scan retry endpoint and audit event for successful ClamAV promotion
Compose opt-in NEXUS_MEDIA_SCAN_ENABLED wiring for API container
Dedicated timeline_render_worker_main process with worker generation registration, heartbeat and graceful SIGTERM cancellation/requeue
Compose timeline-render-worker service with read-only root filesystem, bounded tmpfs, dropped capabilities, no-new-privileges and CPU/memory/PID limits
DejaVu local font installed for deterministic title cards; render staging and artifacts remain under backup-covered nexus_data media tree
Append-only timeline render review queue and immutable per-snapshot decisions bound to adopted artifact SHA-256
Workspace-scoped review decision API requiring review.decide permission and authenticated reviewer identity
Timeline render pending items surfaced in the existing review queue and render status includes immutable review state
Real-media Compose smoke script generating a local source video and exercising title card, timeline gap, source audio mix, ffprobe verification, lease-fenced adoption and artifact-bound review
Compose integration workflow starts and health-checks the dedicated render worker, then runs the real-media render smoke inside its container
Latest Compose CI passed the real FFmpeg/ffprobe media render, artifact adoption, pending review and immutable approval smoke
Container image bakes SHA-256 manifest for FFmpeg and ffprobe; render worker verifies exact configured binary paths and hashes before worker registration
Unit tests cover correct binary hashes, tampering, unlisted binaries and unsafe manifest paths
Latest Compose CI built the image, verified FFmpeg/ffprobe manifest at worker startup, passed real-media render/review smoke and backup/restore checks
Authenticated private media, render submission/status, preview-session and artifact-bound review APIs are covered by route tests
Preview session cookie path and generated preview URL now use the actual artifact/workspace identifiers; native video preview accepts scoped cookie auth
Compose render-worker CPU quota smoke accepts either Docker CpuQuota or NanoCpus while preserving the two-CPU assertion

Authenticated Compose HTTP E2E creates isolated operator workspaces, uploads and quarantines a generated MP4, proves cross-workspace denial, submits an idempotent EDL render through the API, waits for the separate Compose worker to render/adopt, records artifact-bound approval and fetches the private preview through its short-lived cookie

Initial authenticated API-to-worker E2E verified in Compose run 44798390154 and backend run 44798390156 on commit e9f1c124dc545a348dd40c3bd08ae559927878a8. A follow-up CI revision starts freshclam and verifies real ClamAV clean-MP4 plus EICAR rejection; this scanner-backed run is pending.
Bounded timed title overlays rendered from per-job UTF-8 text files with expansion disabled and a trusted configured font; video gaps and overlaps are explicitly rejected
Real-media Compose smoke generates a fixture video and verifies title overlay, audio mix, ffprobe output, lease-fenced artifact adoption, pending review and immutable artifact-hash approval
CI fault-injection coverage verifies process-generation lease loss cancels rendering, discards staged output, allows queue recovery/reclaim, and removes only expired generated staging files
Timeline render worker is opt-in behind the Compose render profile; Compose CI asserts it is absent from the default profile and enabled explicitly for integration smoke

Exact-head integration validation passed: Backend run 44882235365 (914 tests plus Playwright browser smoke) and Compose run 44882235333 (ClamAV database readiness/EICAR detection, worker isolation, real FFmpeg render/adoption/review, authenticated API upload-to-worker render/approval/private preview, encrypted backup and isolated restore). CI uses generated media and isolated Docker volumes; target-host/provider validation remains.

Render worker performs orphaned staging and unindexed artifact reconciliation every 300 seconds with a 7200-second grace period. PR #468 adds structured removal-count and failure-type log events; target persistent filesystem/alert validation and indexed artifact retention remain open.

PR #469 adds an installation-wide 20 GiB default logical cap for indexed render artifacts and a 1 GiB default artifact-volume free-space preflight; the aggregate is checked under the SQLite adoption write lock and fails closed. No indexed artifacts are auto-deleted.

EDL v1 now accepts an optional whole-millisecond project_duration_ms that must cover all clips/audio; the FFmpeg graph emits black segments for initial/internal/trailing gaps and still rejects overlapping video clips.
remaining: Validate representative customer media on the target runtime, including uncommon codecs, variable frame rates and long-duration inputs

Run crash/restart and lease-loss fault injection against the target persistent filesystem; CI regression tests now cover process-generation loss, staging cleanup and lease reclaim in isolated test storage
Validate ClamAV signature freshness and fail-closed scanning on the target runtime before enabling production uploads; CI verifies a current signature database and EICAR rejection.
Validate five-minute orphan reconciliation and its logs on the target persistent filesystem; add durable metrics/alerts. Indexed artifact retention/deletion remains a separate policy gate.

Run end-to-end authenticated API upload → current ClamAV signature scan → render queue → worker adoption → review preview using production-like persistent storage; CI now exercises real ClamAV scanning and EICAR rejection with generated media on isolated Docker volumes, but target storage remains unvalidated.
Measure production workload resource usage and enforce disk quota/network egress policy on the target host
Implement an explicit overlap transition model (for example crossfade) with bounded duration, deterministic audio/video behavior and regression coverage

Define indexed artifact retention/deletion policy separately from the logical cap; existing indexed artifacts are immutable and never auto-deleted. Host/container hard quotas and monitoring still require target-host configuration.
